title: CI name is used twice in one class, or has double spaces
cardHint: Two live CIs of one class have the same name, or a name has two spaces. SACM looks first: one thing twice, retire one.
cardText: Two live CIs of the same class with the same name, or a name with two spaces in a row. A Retired CI, or a CI of another class, with the same name does not count. SACM looks at each line first. Two records for one thing: SACM retires one, and removes the double space itself. Two real CIs: open the CI and press "Two real CIs: ask the owner": the owner gives each one its own name (in EPO for a Business Service or a Service Instance).

playbook.askWhenUnsure: Two real CIs: ask the owner

message.subject: Duplicate name
message.intro: Another live CI of the same class has the same name. They are two different CIs.
message.ask: Could you give each one a name of its own? {Reply} with the right names, and we will update ServiceNow for you.
message.why: A CI is found by its name, so each name must be unique.
